metadata.name: Test strategy, cases, and evidence
metadata.origen: Structure derived from a coverage-and-cases example. No example project content is copied.

prompt.depende: Current SRS and the test commands discovered in the repository. If the SRS is missing, stop in validar mode or write PENDING sections in continuo mode.

estrategia.seccion: Coverage definition and the modules the project calls critical. Do not copy a percentage from another project. A missing threshold is PENDING.
Priority cases tied to requirement identifiers.
Matrix: case, requirement, quality-pipeline gate, and the real tool or script.
Matrix: acceptance criterion and the evidence that would satisfy it.
Metric inventory. A metric without a command is not a result.

casos.campo: Case id, requirement id, preconditions, steps, expected result.
Actual result, status, and SHA stay empty until a run exists.

prompt.evidencia: docs/quality/TEST_EVIDENCE.md records the command, counts, result, and SHA. It does not predict a pass.
